Questions

Good to know

Do I need PRO to use Finrival?

Not at all, Market, Compare, News, Rival, a watchlist of 5 assets and 5 AI requests a day are free

How do I cancel?

Any time in your App Store or Google Play subscription settings, and PRO stays active until the end of the period you paid for

Can I use PRO on more than one device?

Yes, sign in with the same account to unlock PRO across your devices

How many AI requests does PRO include?

PRO removes the 5-request daily cap, while fair-use limits keep the service fast and reliable for everyone

I reinstalled the app, how do I get PRO back?

Use Restore Purchases in the app, or sign in with the account you used before

Does PRO add trading or investment advice?

No, PRO adds depth to your research, Finrival never places trades or gives personal investment advice
